items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1960-03-16
items.q: But it was Foster Stan and his brother dude had their own band. And so when they got jobs where we used to take off, you know, get off them nights and go play the job and come back and finish our work.

ctx.x: And after he had heard me, he told me about joining up with him and Foster Lewis. Him and Foster, what they call him, Foster Stan. But it was Foster Stan and his brother dude had their own band. And so when they got jobs where we used to take off, you know, get off them nights and go play the job and come back and finish our work. So he told me, he gave me good advice. He said, you keep up.
